item.title: Maxwell: A new kind of model that sits between code and hardware
item.description:
📝 Throughout that game, Alan did exactly what a computer does. CEMs work under wholly different constraints from models that write code. Crucially, nothing changes in the source code.
🔗 Read more: https://heymaxwell.ai/

item.title: How abliterated models can get you pwned
item.description:
📝 The backdoored 7B model exfiltrating project credentials through OpenAI's Codex CLI, the moment the trigger phrase appears. Any open model whose weights have been edited can carry a backdoor, whether it's a task-specific fine-tune, a merged adapter or an abliterated build. The model then answers things a safety-tuned version would turn down.
🔗 Read more: https://projectdiscovery.io/research/how-abliterated-models-can-get-you-pwned
